tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chog las rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho la 'jug pa bzhugs/
༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chog las rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho la 'jug pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chog las rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho la 'jug pa bzhugs/

oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwe na mo na maḥ bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan/ / dus sbyor bcu gnyis 'gags pa ste/ /kun mkhyen skye dgu'i bdag po la/ /btud nas slob dpon dbang bskur bshad/ 'dir sdom ni/ gsol dang gsol gdab chu cod pan/ /dar dpyangs brtul zhugs phyag rgya drug /rjes gnang gnyis dang 'dogs lnga dang*/ /dbang bzhi rdo rje gsum byin rlabs/ ched brjod mchod pa brtan bzhugs dang*/ /dam tshig dang ni phan yon sgrags/ /dbugags dbyung gzengs bstod rjes kyi chos/ /bdag po'i dbang bskur yin par bshad/ /rig ma bshams shing dag pa brjod/ /bka' zhu bkas gnang gsol ba gdab// rig ma gtad cing 'khor lo sgom/ /bde ba sgom zhing chu dbang bskur/ /bkas gnang dbang bzhi bskur ba dang*/ /bzhi pa la ni ched brjod lhag /rjes kyi bya ba rnam gnyis te/ /bdag po chen po'i dbang yin no/ /de la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni rnam pa gnyis te/ bdag po'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ bdag po chen po'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ kye dpal ldan bla ma khyed kyi bka' drin las/ da ni bdag gis bde bar gshegs pa'i lam thams cad shes so/ /dus 'di nas brtsams te khyed dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spangs nas/ bla ma gzhan bsten par mi bgyi'o/ /gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*/ /thugs rjes gter gyis bdag la stsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab ste/ tshig bcad 'di yang gzhan dang go bstun pa'o/ / sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi/ / sogs kyis kyang lan gsum gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol lam ngos yangs par/ dbang stegs bcas pa'i steng du dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bkod la/ bu mo brgyad kyis bum pa brgyad bzung*/ gzhon nu ma gnyis kyis rgyal rnam rgyal gnyis bzung ste/ bum chu bsdu ba nas brtsams/

chu dbang dang*/ cod pan gyi dbang dang*/ dar dpyangs kyi dbang dang*/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang rnams byis 'jug gi dbang dang 'dra bar bskur ba las/ khyad par ni/ dbang gi dag pa rnams brjod mi dgos/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang rdzas mthe bong rdo rje byed pa yin pas/ me tog sil ma nag po zhes sogs/ me tog sil ma ljang khu nas/ sngon po zhes pa'i bar la/ mthe bo'i rdo rje sor gdub zhes pa'am/ mthe bo'i rdo rje yang gcig gam gnyis las med na/ mthe bo'i rdo rje sor gdub kyi cha shas gcig ces 'don pa spo/ slob ma dus kyi 'khor lo phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ dbang rdzas/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ haṃ las byung ba'i spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa zhal gsum nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i spyi bo'i 'khor lo nor bu dang bcas pa'i mgo rgyan du gyur/ oṃ haṃ pañca ā kā ra mahā shū n+ya ta swa bhā ba badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si hūṃ phaṭa/ mi bskyod 'khor lo'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lus mchog la ni rnam brgyan zhing*/ /srid pa gsum du 'khor lo bskor/ /lus mchog la gnas chu rgyun gyi/ /cig car chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'gro ba'i don chen byed par 'gyur/ / zhes sbyin/ rna rgyan gnyis haṃ haḥlas byung pa'i 'od dpag med zhal gsum nas/ bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rna rgyan du gyur/ oṃ haṃ haḥbā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kar+ṇa yor badz+ra kun+ṭa li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ dpag med rna cha'i gzugs kyis ni/ /rna ba dag la rnam brgyan nas/ /srid pa gsum la chags par bya/ /de 'dis 'gro ba'i don byed gyur/ /mgul rgyan aṃ las byung ba'i rin chen 'byung ldan zhal gsum nas/ 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa de zhu ba las byung ba'i mgul brgyan du 'gyur/ oṃ aṃ kan+ṭhe badz+ra kan+ṭh-i ke hūṃ phaṭa/ rin chen mgul rgyan gzugs kyis ni/ /bdag gi mgul ba rnam brgyan te/

/'gro 'di ro yis btul byas nas/ /'gro ba chu bzhin 'jug par 'gyur/ /lag gdub a āḥdang*/ rkang gdub ha hāḥlas byung ba'i rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum nas/ dril bu 'dzin pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lag gdub dang rkang gdub tu gyur/ oṃ ā ā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa kau hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hāḥbā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da yor badz+ra nū pu re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ rnam snang lag gdub gzugs nyid kyis/ /lag pa dag la rnam brgyan te/ /'gro ba'i don la 'jug byas na/ / skye ba sa ltar brtan par 'gyur/ /ska rags aḥlas byung ba'i don yod grub pa zhal gsum nas/ dkar po 'dzin pa/ zhu ba las byung ba'i ska rags su gyur/ oṃ āḥkaṭ+yāṃ badz+ra me kha lā hūṃ phaṭa/ don yod ska rags gzugs nyid kyis/ /sked pa la ni rnam brgyan pa/ /'gro 'di rlung gis btul byas nas/ / thog med rlung gis 'gro ba 'dul/ /thal chen waṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i thal chen du gyur/ oṃ waṃ sarba ang ge b+tasmi hūṃ phaṭa/ gnas gsum sogs su byug tshul bya/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /thal ba'i lus la rnam brgyan te/ mchog gi spyod pa rab sbyang nas/ /bde ba'i yid kyis 'gro ba 'dul/ / zhes brjod/ de nas rjes gnang ni/ 'di skad ces bya ste / gdug pa sdigs par byed pa'i mchog /gang gis ngur smrig mthong tsam gyis/ /lha min sa yis 'og tu 'phros/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bya/ /stong nyid snying rjer khyod byin rlabs/ /stong nyid snying rje rgyun mi 'chad/ /mtshan mar rdo rje dril bu bzung*/ /ji lta de ltar gzhan la ston/ /khyod ni yongs rdzogs slob dpon te/ /gnas brtan rgan po'ang khyod nyid yin/ khyod ni bsil gyur rnyog pa med/ /dge slong dgra bcom zag pa zad/ /'dzag pa'i 'dod chags rab spangs pas/ khyod kyi zug rngu ma lus bton/

/gzhan la phan pa'i gang zag mchog /khyod ni mngon sum sangs rgyas sras/ / zhes dang*/ de rjes spro na lugs gzhan gyi rig pa sbyar te/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid/ che dang dril bu chen po bzung*/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma bsdu ba nyid du bgyis/ / de bzhin du/ dbang gi don du sa ni yong brtag nags dang grong khyer grong rdal grong gi phyogs kyi cha dag dang*/ /thab khung rnams kyis mtshan nyid dang ni bum pa dang bcas rdul tshon sbyin sreg phur bu la sogs dang*/ /slob ma rnams ni bsdu ba dag dang gang yang rgyal ba'i bdag pos mchog gi dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ /shes nas slob dpon gyis ni dge dang mi dge'i 'bras slad zhi ba la sogs mtha' dag rab tu bya/ / zhes brjod/ rjes gnang 'di tsam gyis chog la/ spros pa la mngon par dga' na/ yi ge rnying pa mang po zhig la yod pa bzhin du/ lag len la yang byed pa mang du yod pa ltar/ dbang bdun nang gi rjes gnang dag pa brjod pa bor ba de byas nas/ sngags dang*/ mig thur dang*/ me long dang*/ mda' gzhu rnams byis 'jug slob ma la bskur ba'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin dang*/ chos bshad kyi rjes gnang bdag 'jug gi skabs ltar byed pa'ang yod mod kyi nges par dgos pa ni ma yin la/ rdo rje slob dpon du sgrub pa la ma 'brel ba'ang med do/ /'dir lung bstan byed pa ni shes byed yang dag pa ci yang med do/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon du sgrub pa'i bya ba mchog slar yang bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang rnams bdag 'jug gi skabs su bshad pa bzhin du bskur/ slar yang sku gsung thugs rdo rje byin gyis brlab pa'i daun du/ mchod phyir thogs/ a aḥ.aṃ las byung ba'i sku rdo rje zhal gsum nas/ yum dang bcas pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod phyir thogs su gyur/ oṃ a āḥ.aṃ sarba swā ra e ka tri swā ra swa bhā ba badz+ra yā dz+nyā+o pa bī ta/

skan dhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ / sogs sho lo ka gnyis brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gsung gi don du me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i phyag mtshan gyis dbang bskur bar bshad kyang*/ ngos zin pa dka' na rig drug gi phyag mtshan/ a i ṛ u l̥ aṃ zhes pa rnams las byung ba'i gsung rdo rje zhal gsum nas/ yum dang bcas pa/ de zhu ba las rigs drug gi phyag mtshan du gyur/ oṃ a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū l̥ l̥̄ aṃ aḥswāhā/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ / sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bāka badz+ra sogs brjod/ dar dpyangs aṃ yig las dang*/ cod pan haṃ yig las byung ba'i thugs rdo rje zhal gsum nas/ yum dang bcas pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i dar dpyangs dang cod pan du gyur/ oṃ aṃ artā nā rī shwa ra badz+ra tsan+d+ra badz+ra paṭ+ṭa un+dhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ pañca ā kā ra sogs gong bzhin brjod/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ / sogs dang*/ tsit+ta badz+ra/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ tshangs pa sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsung gi rdo rje dbang phyug che/ / rgyal po thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /de nyid khyab 'jug rdzu 'phrul che/ /rdo rje slob dpon khyod nyid do/ /gtsug phud phud bu lcang lo can/ /ral pa muñja cod pan thogs/ /gdong lnga gtsug phud lnga dang ldan/ zur phud lnga pa me tog thod/ / ces brjod la mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor la brtan bzhugs bya/ 'dir ston pa po'i dbang la mngon par dbang skur ba'i dge slong ngam/ dge tshul lam/ khyim pas g.yogs la sogs pa'i chos dang*/ khyim pa'i chos mi bya'o/ /gal te ral gri dang*/ snag tsha dang*/ tshong la sogs pa byed na/ de'i bka' bcag par 'gyur zhing*/ bka' bcag pa las mnar med pa 'gro bar 'gyur te/ slob dpon gyi chos rnam par bshig pa'i phyir ro/

/phan yon ni/ 'dir rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas ni/ dkyil 'khor thams cad du dbang bskur ba ste/ mu stegs pa rnams kyi lha dang lha mo khyab 'jug dang drag po la sogs pa dang*/ tsar tsi ka la sogs pa rnam par sbyangs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor yang sgrub pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud thams cad du dbang bskur bar 'gyur zhing*/ rgyud thams cad kyi ston pa po dang*/ sngags thams cad kyi rjes su gnang ba po dang*/ dngos grub thams cad kyi sgrub pa po ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud ston pa po rdo rje slob dpon ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ji lta ba dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang po'i sangs rgyas ji lta ba de bzhin du thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyis blta bar bya'o/ /de nas dbugs dbyung ba ni/ slob ma'i steng du gdugs bzung la thal mo sbyar/ bskor ba byas shar sgo nas bla ma dang lha la 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ / sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bri/ khyod kyis nan tan skyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ / phan btags drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*/ /khyed la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ / ces so/ /de nas slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ / zhes sogs gzengs bstod rgyas pa bya/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod do/ /de la phyag rgya drug gi tshigs bcad dang*/ dbang bdun gyi nang gi rjes gnang 'dogs bcas rnams dang*/

rdo rje gsum gyi tshigs bcad gsol gdab/ nga rgyal bzung ba rnams dang*/ dbugs dbyung dang gzengs bstod rnams bor kyang*/ cho ga chad pa'i nyes par mi 'gyur la/ phyag rgya drug brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi dod yin pa'i/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa la brtul zhugs kyi dbang logs su bskur ba mi dgos kyang*/ rdo rje sor gdub kyi dbang 'di nyid gzhan la sbyin pa'i don du thob na bzang ba'i phyir/ 'di yang byed pa nyid legs so/ /rgyas par na lha skyed pa thams cad la gnas gzhi byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ mchod pa byed pa sogs dang*/ sku gsung thugs rdo rjer byed pa'i skabs/ dbang rdzas byin ma thag tu/ las rgyal mchog gi skabs bzhin rdo rje gsum byin rlabs shing*/ dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa 'bogs pa yang yod de/ rgyas pa'i lugs yin pas/ spro na de ltar bya ba mi 'gal la/ bsdu na dbang rdzas rnams sa bon de dang de la ma byung ba/ lha so so'i ngo bor mos pa tsam gyis kyang go chod pa ni yin no/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rigs gsum las/ dge slong la dbang stegs/ rwa ba lnga'i re khā 'dom gang gru bzhi pa'i dbus su shing stan rgyar gru do ba dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ tshon sna lngas bris pa dang*/ dge tshul la re khā gru do pa dang*/ pad+ma ma bris pa'i shing stan dang*/ khyim pa la rwa ba gsum gyi re khā khru gang ba'i dbus su/ stan nang tshangs can phal pa zhig 'god par bshad/ dge tshul la bu mo bzhis bum pa bzhi dang*/ gzhon nu ma gnyis gong bzhin te/ dbang yang chu dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur zhing*/ phyag rgya bcing ba man chad sngar dang 'dra'o/ khyim pa la ni bu mo gcig gis bum pa dang*/ gzhon nu ma gcig gis rnam par rgyal ba bzung zhing*/ chu dbang dang*/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang tsam sbyin/ rjes gnang man chad 'dra'o/ /dge tshul dang khyim pa gnyis la/ gang gis ngur smrig

zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig po de mi brjod par bshad cing*/ de rnams lag len la yang yod mod/ lhag par mos pa'i dbang las mtha' gcig tu nges pa yang med par mngon no/ /gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pas/ bdag po'i dbang bskur bshad pa las/ dge ba cung zad gang thob des/ /'gro kun rgyal ba'i bdag por shog /da ni bdag po chen po'i dbang bskur ba bshad par bya ste/ man+ṭal la sogs pa sngon du song bas/ rig ma bcu dngos su star ba'am/ yid kyi yul du gsal btab nas/ slob ma khyim pa yin na rang rigs kyi rig ma bcu slob dpon la 'bul/ slob ma rab tu byung ba yin na/ de la slob dpon gyis dbang gi don du gzhan rigs kyis rig ma bcu sbyin bar bya ba sta ེ/ tsha mo dang ni bu mo dang*/ /sring mo de bzhin skyed byed ma/ /de bzhin chung ma'i ma dang ni/ /de bzhin zhang po'i bud med dang*/ /pha yi spun zla'i chung ma dang*/ de bzhin pha yi sring mo dang*/ /rang gi ma yi spun zla nyid/ /rang gi chung ma mchog gzugs can/ /sgrol ma la sogs chos khams mthar/ /rang rigs las skyes rig ma bcu/ /thar pa 'dod pas khyim pa yis/ /dbang gi dus su rab dbul bya/ /rig ma 'di rnams rigs srung phyir/ /gal te bla mar mi 'bul na/ /de tshe khyim na gnas pa la/ /gzhan gyi dbang bskur sbyin mi bya// dge slong dge tshul rnams la ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur ba'i/ / dmangs rigs skyes sogs gzhan dag gis/ /bla mas sbyin bya mi yi bdag/ rlung sogs rim pas dmangs rigs mo/ /rgyal rigs de bzhin bram ze mo// rje mo g.yung mo nya pa mo/ /gar ma de bzhin tshos mkhan mo/ /ko lpags byed ma gtum mo ni/ /chos khams mthar skyes ma ste bcu/ /rig ma chen mor yang dag brjod/ /longs spyod grol 'bras rab tu ster/ /de dag kyang pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang*/ dbang bcu dang*/ sa bcu dang*/ stobs bcu rnams rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/

/sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /thub pa chen po thub chen ldan/ /gsang sngags tshul chen las byung ba/ /gsang sngags tshul can bdag nyid can/ /pha rol phyin bcu thob pa ste/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu la gnas/ /pha rol phyin bcu dag pa ste/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu yi tshul// mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste/ /sa bcu la ni gnas pa po/ /shes bcu rnam dag bdag nyid can/ /shes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po/ /rnam pa bcu po don bcu'i don/ /thub dbang stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag /shes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po/ /rnam pa bcu po don bcu'i don/ /thub dbang stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag /kun gyi don ni ma lus byed/ /rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po/ /

zhes brjod/ de nas slob mas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai/ bcom ldan 'das pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad thob pa/ da ni bdag gis ci zhig bgyi/ / zhes so/ /de la slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ bcu yis nang nas/ rang gi chung ma de bzung nas/ de dang lhan cig tu bdag la gsol ba gdab par byos shig de yang khyim pas rang rigs lo nyi shu ma dang*/ rab byung la ni gtum mo mthar skyes lo nyi shu ma chos khams rdo rje ma sngon mor gyur pa chung mar bsam par bya'o/ / de dang lhan cig tu slob dpon la man+ṭal phul nas/ gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ khyed kyi sku la sha khrag dang*/ /bshang gci shu kra ma mchis shing*/ / bco brgyad khams kyang mi mnga' ba/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi/ / sogs lan gsum/ chung ma'i ma'am g.yung mo lo bco lnga ma sgra rdo rje ma ljang khur gyur pa/ rgyan bkrol zhing phyogs gyi gos can du byas te/ lha mo dga' ster sogs kyis slob ma la gtad/ des kyang slob ma la 'khyud par gyur/ slob ma dus kyi 'khor lor gyur pa la/ sgra rdo rje ma ljang khus g.yon phyogs nas 'khyud pa dang*/ de bzhin du shar du lo bcu gcig ma sgrol ma nag mo/ lhor lo bcu gnyis ma gos dkar mo dmar mo/ byang du lo bcu gsum ma mā ma kī dkar mo/ nub tu lo bcu bzhi ma spyan ma ser mo/ shar lhor lo bcu drug ma reg bya rdo rje ma nag mo/ lho nub tu lo bcu bdun ma ro rdo rje ma dmar mo/ byang shar du lo bco brgyad ma gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo/ nub byang du lo bcu dgu ma dri rdo rje ma ser mo/ rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo rig ma dgu po thams cad gcer mo skra grol ba/ phyag na gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa'o/ / de nas rig ma dgu po rnams rim pa bzhin thams cad kyis 'khyud pa las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su bstar bar byas/ slar yang gong bzhin bdag po'i dbang gi skabs su bstan pa ltar/

rig ma bcu la sogs pas bum pa bzung ste/ chu dbang bskur/ stong nyid snying rje khyod byin rlabs/ / zhes pa nas/ mngon sum sangs rgyas sras kyi bar rjes gnang byin/ slar yang maṇ+ḍal byas te/ /oṃ oṃ sogs bum dbang gi gsol gdab bya/ rig ma zhun ma'i gser dang mtshungs shing*/ rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa'i bu mo mdzes ma lo bcu gnyis nas/ nyi shus mthar thug pa rdul dang ldan pa rnams la slob dpon gyis 'khyud par byas shing*/ de'i 'og tu slob ma la slar yang gtad de/ rim gyi nu ma la lag pas reg pa las byung ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis kyang lo nyi shu ma chos khams rdo rje ma nu ma nyed par byas pa la/ mthong ba'i yul du gyur pa las thob pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi sogs nas/ nga rgyal bzung ba'i bar slob ma'i dbang du bshad pa'i skabs dang 'dra te bum dbang ngo*/ /gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ āḥ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon dus kyi 'khor lo gsal ba dang*/ chung ma'i ma'am g.yung mo sgra rdo rje mar gyur pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa nas/ dhū tī'i lam nas rgyud de rdo rje nor bu byon pa na/ slob ma dang*/ de'i rig ma chung ma'am/ gtum mo chos khams rdo rje ma'i bdag nyid can/ gnyis ka'i khar rdo rje nor bu bzhag ste/ byang chub kyi sems yang dag par dbab cing*/ shes rab kyi na ra nā si ka la gnas pa'i rdul gyi dwangs ma yang rdo rje nor bus yang dag par gzhibs pa slob ma'i khar 'phangs par gyur/ ji ltar sogs/ lhag ma slob ma dbang bskur skabs kyi gsang dbang dang 'dra'au/ /maṇ+ḍal dang*/ oṃ hūṃ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ chung ma'am gtum mo lo nyi shu ma chos khams rdo rje ma'i bdag nyid can dang*/ slob dpon dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gyur pa snyoms par zhugs pa las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mngon du byas nas/ slar yang rig ma de nyid gtad/

'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po lags zhes pa nas/ āt+ma ko3haṃ gi bar slob ma'i dbang gi shes rab ye shes dang 'dra/ de'i 'og tu rig ma gzhan rnams la yang*/ ji ltar nus par gnyis sbyor gyi rjes su chags pa brtsam par bya ste/ mtshan mo phyed nas ji srid du chu tshod gnyis kyi rjes la nyi ma 'char ba de srid du'o/ / de lta bu'i sbyor ba las byung ba'i zhes pa nas/ phyi rol rang lces blangs/ zhes pa'i bar yang slob ma'i dbang gi skabs dang 'dra ste shes rab ye shes so/ /dbang gi rab byed dang dbang bzhi pa la ni/ tshig tu brjod pa'i rim pa/ slob ma'i dbang gi cho gar bshad pa kho na yin la/ dbang bzhi pa dngos dang*/ nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags kyi bar du/ 'jig rten gsum na gzhon lus gcig / gnas brtan rgan po skye dgu'i bdag /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ / sdug gu 'jig rten gsum na mdzes/ /'jig rten shes legs slob dpon te/ / zhes dang*/ phyir mi zlog pa phyir mi 'ong*/ /'dren pa rang rgyal bse ru'i tshul/ /nges 'byung sna tshogs las byung ba/ /'byung ba chen po rgyu gcig pu/ / dge slong dgra bcom zag pa zad/ /'dod chags bral bas dbang po thul// bde ba brnyes pas 'jigs med thob/ bsil bar gyur bas rnyaug pa med/ / mgo zlum brtul zhugs chen po 'chang*/ /tshangs par spyod pa brdul zhugs mchog /dka' thub mthar phyin dka' thub che/ /gtsang gnas dam pa gau ta ma/ /bram ze tshangs pa tshangs pa shes/ /mya ngan 'das pa tshangs pa thob/ / grol ba thar pa rnam grol lus/ /rnam grol zhi ba zhi ba nyid/ / ces brjod/ 'di'i cho ga ni snga ma dang 'dra ba shas che yang*/ dbang gi ye shes rtogs tshul gyi khyad par ni ches lhag pa yin no/ /mjug tu/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ / zhes sogs dang*/ ral gri dang ni sogs kyang brjod pa'i lag len yod pa ltar bya ste/ bdag po chen po'i dbang gi rim pa'o/ /bdag po chen po'i dbang 'di slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka grub pa'am rnal 'byor pa'i gnas thob pa'am/

ma thob kyang skal ba mchog lhag par mos pa brtan po kho nas bya ba yin kyang*/ deng sang dus kyi mtha' 'di lta bu la/ grub pa dang rnal 'byor ma'i dpon slob dkon cing*/ yod kyang mngon shes med pa'i phyir na ngo mi shes pa dang*/ zab mo'i dbang gi rnam pa lam du byed pa yang rgyun chad du phangs pa yin pas/ tha na yang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi tshul du zhes kyang thob par bya'o/ /'di ni nges par tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang rjes su 'brel ba yin te/ bum dbang gi sngon dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi mthar nges par sbyar ro/ / slob ma'i dbang gi dbang gong ma dang*/ bdag po'i dbang dang*/ bdag po chen po'i dbang 'di rnams ni/ slob dpon rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes can nam/ bskyed rim la cung zad brtan pas ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba las gzhan pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa mi dgos shing*/ las dang po pa'i slob dpon la yang*/ slob mas dbang thob par 'gyur ba'i yan lag tu/ de dgos pa ma yin kyang*/ slob dpon nyid kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi slad du dkyil 'khor sgrub pa nges par bya ba yin la/ de yang dbang bdun sogs dang 'brel bar phyi dkyil yod na'ang legs shing*/ gzhan du na yang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs su rdzogs pa'am thugs dkyil tsam gyi sgom bzlas dang*/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchod chog mchod gtor rgyas pa dang bcas pa dang*/ spro zhing nus na bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo las ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas bdag 'jug kyang blang bar bya'o/ /'dir thams cad mkhyen pa jo nang pa chen po'i bzhed pas/ las dang po pa'i slob dpon dang slob ma'i dbang gang yin yang rung ste/ dbang gong ma dang po gsum la gong ma dang*/ bzhi pa la gong ma'i gong ma zhes/ gong chung dang gong chen gyi dbye ba dang*/ dbang bcu gcig po dkyus ma 'di slob ma'i dbang dang*/ chu dang phyag rgya sbyin pa sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i dbang gong ma bzhi rdo rje gsum du sgrub pa dang bcas pa ni/

bdag po'i dbang dang*/ rig ma bcu dang bcas pa ni bdag po chen po'i dbang ngo*/ /des na las dang po pa'i gang zag la/ nyan pa'i don dang 'chad pa'i don gyi dbang gong ma rnam pa gnyis dang*/ gang zag mchog la bskur ba'i dbang gong ma gcig ste gsum mo/ /dang po gnyis char la yang*/ bum dbang sogs dbang gsum ni 'jig rten pa'i dbang dang*/ bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang yin pas gong chen gong chung gnyis gnyis dang*/ 'jig rten 'jig rtain 'das pa gnyis gnyis so/ /rjes mthun mos pa lam byed tsam ma yin par dngos kyi dbang du byas na/ phyi ma'i dbang bzhi po thams cad kyang*/ 'gyur med kyi gnas thob pa'i nges pas/ gong ma chen po dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa kho na'o/ /'di la chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis kyang*/ bdag po'i dbang la dbang bzhi mi bskur ba sogs 'dra min mdzad la/ bu ston chen po sogs mkhas pa phyis byon gzhan rnams kyi bzhed tshul dang ni mi 'dra ba shin tu che zhing*/ snga rabs rnams la ni/ lugs 'di dang mthun pa dang*/ phal cher mthun pa dang*/ phyis byon gzhan rnams dang phal cher mthun pa dang*/ gnyis ka dang mi mthun pa'i 'dod tshul te/ mi 'dra ba shin tu mang por mthong ngo*/ /'on kyang dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi dgongs don ni sngar bshad pa kho nar gsal la/ kho bo rang nyid kyi blo gros kyi nus pa'i stobs las cha shas tsam yang rtogs pa ma yin mod kyi/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho man ngag dang bcas pa'i lde mig gis/ rgyud 'grel chen po'i nges gsang gi sgo rnam par phye pa las/ bdag lta bus kyang nges pa thob ste/ rgyu mtshan mang po bshad du yod pa ni/ 'dir bris na yig ge mang bar 'gyur ba'i gzhan du bshad par 'dod do/ /zab mo'i dbang bskur mthar thug pa'i/ /cho ga dag gsal 'khyer bde ba/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /tā ra nā thas bkod pa yin/ /'di las dge ba ci thob pa/

/des ni sems can ma lus kun/ /rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung sku/ / gdod nas gnas pa mngon 'gyur shog /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo so brgyad pa la/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo mo nang gi dam chos gling du sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ/ swasti/ bla na med pa'i dbang gi cho ga 'di/ /rgyal ba'i rigs 'khrungs mi bdag chen po yis/ /dad dang lhag bsam dkar bas bka' stsal te/ /brkos kyi rig byed mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /par du bzhengs nas chos gter rgya cher spel/ dge tshogs 'di la mngon du phyogs pa rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i/ /dam pa gnyis po mngon du 'gyur bar shog /maṅga laṃ/ 'dir 'bad dge ba rnam par dkar ba'i mthus/ /bdag lus bor tshe dpal ldan sham+bha lar/ /rigs ldan rgyal po'i 'khor du legs skyes nas/ /dus 'khor bstan la bya ba byed par shog /ces pa 'di ni chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis smon lam btab pa'o/ /dge ba 'di yis glo bur dri ma'i tshogs/ /srog dang thur sel rtsa dang lhan cig tu/ /'joms par nus pa'i thabs zab la brten nas/ / gzhan mchog bde gshegs sny-ing po myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni rton pa bzhi ldan gyis smon lam mdzad pa'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chog las rdo rje slopa dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 240--PAGE 253--PAGE 239-
